question: Which months are known for the season of retreating monsoon in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**October and November**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **October and November** are the months known for the season of retreating monsoon in India.
 
• During this period, the southwest monsoon winds withdraw from the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The retreating monsoon is characterized by clear skies, a drop in temperature, and dry weather conditions.
 
• This season marks the transition from the rainy season to the onset of winter in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The retreating monsoon season is also known as the **Northeast Monsoon** season in southern parts of India.
 
• It is crucial for the Rabi crop season as it provides the necessary moisture for the crops.
 
• States like Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Karnataka receive significant rainfall during this period.
 
• The weather patterns during this season can sometimes lead to cyclonic activities in the Bay of Bengal.
